**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Cobweb](../persons.html#675),
I am glad to tell you that no one has passed you, though [Firefly](../persons.html#1168) is your equal, in the number of votes, and I therefore should like to know which of [Mother Goose](../others.html#104)’s works you would like best to have- only do not expect it immediately as I should like to have it bound for you.

Thank you for letting me see the photograph I am glad you have got it as it is much better than the only one I have now to give away The broken negative was not quite so good as this.
[Humble Bee](../persons.html#81), [Irene](../persons.html#538) and Stormy Petrel[^1] are the three best this time
your affectionate
Mother Goose

[^1]: Stormy Petrel, or Petrel, was a member of the Gosling Society, but her identity is uncertain.
